name: Marilith
summary: A many-armed serpentine demon that strikes with blades, constricts, teleports, and parries.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {ref:glossary/hit-points} somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The marilith has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.text: The marilith can take one {ref:glossary/reaction} on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Constrict

save.targets: one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}), and it has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.text: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
